search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail MFAUsed 
| json "eventName", "errorCode", "additionalEventData.MFAUsed" as eventName, errorCode, MFAUsed nodrop 
| where isBlank(errorCode) and eventName="ConsoleLogin" 
| if(MFAUsed="No",1,0) as NotAuth 
| sum(NotAuth) as count 
| "IAM_ConsoleLoginsNoMfa" as benchmarkname 
| "EventCount" as type 
| fillmissing values("IAM_ConsoleLoginsNoMfa") in benchmarkname, values("EventCount") in type 
| toInt(count) as count
